description: Build real registration/login system: add bcrypt password hashing, parent self-registration with OTP, staff account creation from admin panel, password change on first login, and parent-limited data access. Remove plaintext password comparison. Create a registration UI page and update the admin panel.
steps: Install bcrypt (npm install bcrypt && npm install -D @types/bcrypt) for password hashing

Create supabase/migrations/202608180003_registration_system.sql that: (1) adds columns to auth_users: mobile_number VARCHAR(15), must_change_password BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, password_changed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, parent_student_ids UUID[] (for parent-child linking), created_by UUID (who created the account); (2) creates an index on mobile_number; (3) hashes the existing plaintext passwords in auth_users using a one-time update (use pgcrypto crypt/gen_salt for in-DB hashing OR just mark them for must_change_password=true)

Update server/auth.ts: (1) Replace the plaintext password comparison (user.password_hash !== password) with bcrypt.compare(password, user.password_hash). (2) Add POST /api/auth/register endpoint for parent self-registration: accepts fullName, mobileNumber (10-digit Indian), email, relationship; validates inputs; checks unique mobile/email; creates user with role=student_parent, must_change_password=false (they set password after OTP verify); initiates OTP challenge to their email; after OTP verified, prompts password creation. (3) Add POST /api/auth/change-password endpoint: requires session; validates old password (or skip if must_change_password); hashes new password with bcrypt; updates auth_users; sets must_change_password=false. (4) Add POST /api/admin/create-account endpoint: requires web_creator/principal session; accepts fullName, email, mobileNumber, role (staff roles only); generates temporary password; hashes with bcrypt; creates user with must_change_password=true; sends email with temp password via Resend. (5) Add rate limiting to all new endpoints.

Create src/components/RegisterPage.tsx: registration form with fields for Full Name, Mobile Number (10-digit validation), Email, Relationship to Student dropdown. On submit calls /api/auth/register, shows OTP entry, then password-set form. Follow the visual style of LoginPage.tsx (emerald/green theme, glass-card, motion animations).
Create src/components/ChangePasswordPage.tsx: form for current password + new password + confirm new password. Shown when must_change_password is true after login.

Update src/contexts/AppContext.tsx: add mustChangePassword to AuthUser interface and state; add register() and changePassword() methods; update session check to detect must_change_password flag from server response.
Update src/App.tsx: if mustChangePassword is true, show ChangePasswordPage instead of dashboard. Add routing to show RegisterPage (via a 'Register' link on LoginPage).
Update src/components/LoginPage.tsx: add a 'Register as Parent' link/button that switches to registration view.

Update server/data.ts: for role=student_parent, filter /api/students to only return students linked via parent_student_ids on their auth_users record. Add GET /api/parent/my-children endpoint that returns only the parent's linked students.
Update the SuperAdminCenter.tsx or add account management UI in the admin panel to call POST /api/admin/create-account for staff account creation
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint passes with all new code
server/auth.ts uses bcrypt.compare for password verification instead of plaintext comparison
POST /api/auth/register endpoint exists with proper validation and rate limiting
POST /api/admin/create-account endpoint exists requiring web_creator/principal role
RegisterPage component renders with proper form fields
ChangePasswordPage component renders and is shown when mustChangePassword=true
Parent role data access is restricted to linked students only
No hardcoded admin/Admin@2024 plaintext comparison remains in auth code
